name: Can a contractor handle neglected or foreclosed rental property rehabs?

mainEntity.name: Can a contractor handle neglected or foreclosed rental property rehabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an owner-operated contractor can coordinate complete foreclosed or neglected rental rehabs from clean-up through final finishes. Severe tenant neglect often leaves broken drywall, damaged interior doors, ruined subflooring, and water-damaged bathrooms. A general contractor coordinates essential rough-in updates with electrical and plumbing trades while managing finish carpentry, custom framing, full bathroom re-tiling, drywall hanging, and full-interior repainting. This integrated approach allows property owners to resolve deep neglect efficiently under one lead supervisor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a general contractor can oversee complete rehabs, handling drywall, tile, carpentry, and paint while coordinating sub-trades to restore heavily damaged rentals.
